review.notes: Full review. All eight sampled targets and every other locator of the README read against the two sources (RVW02 from arXiv, HLW06 from the publisher's open copy; the sources service recorded both in the package manifest). Every Check value recomputed numerically; the seven theorems tested on 600 random involutive rotation maps and in the degenerate cases (no ports, no vertices, one vertex). Suggested.lean elaborates with sorry as the only warning; the one-tactic probe closes none of the seven theorems. All 23 cited library declarations opened at the pins; the dependency check reports 0 problems; the automatic checks all passed and none was set aside. Two source errors recorded (RVW Theorem 6.4 as printed; a remark in HLW section 9.3).
